diagnosis.cause: The override freezes clock() and performance.now() at zero. Phase-A field-source preparation calls fieldBoundLemmas with closure:false and a normal 250-unit local ceiling. That ceiling no longer expires. A nested grow consumes 49,100.1342596 units before the global 50,000-unit stop, before any numeric leaf. Normal production abandons bounded preparation and reaches its first numeric leaf after 701.1505864 op-local units.
diagnosis.caveat: This is not the same production procedure with only a larger total allowance. It cannot establish a 50,000-unit lower bound on production need. Inclusive function totals overlap; exclusive units and wall are the additive columns.
